prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: whiplash. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1360; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change on a multi-lane roadway. Insured vehicle contacted the left rear quarter panel of the claimant vehicle. Both drivers reported to be ambulatory at scene. Police report requested. Initial contact made with the claimant by phone; claimant states no attorney retained at this time.

Entry 2: Recorded statement obtained from insured. Insured states they checked mirrors and signaled before moving into the adjacent lane, and did not see the claimant vehicle in the blind spot. Photos of both vehicles received and added to file. Damage appears consistent with the reported angle of contact.

Entry 3: Claimant reports neck pain and stiffness beginning the day after the collision, with headaches and limited rotation of the head. Claimant states they were seen at an urgent care facility and given a diagnosis of whiplash. Medical records requested with signed authorization. Claimant confirmed they are not represented by counsel and was advised of the claims process.

Entry 4: Independent appraisal completed on claimant vehicle. Damage estimate received and under review. Rental vehicle authorized for the claimant under the terms of the policy. Follow-up call placed to claimant to confirm rental pickup and ask about ongoing symptoms; claimant reports pain is unchanged and has been referred to a physical therapy provider.

Entry 5: Medical records received and reviewed. Treatment notes support a whiplash soft-tissue diagnosis with no fracture noted. Liability assessment in progress based on the statement, photos, and police report. Claimant updated on status and told a settlement evaluation will follow once treatment is complete. File flagged for supervisor review due to injury component.
